{

    {
      "id": "G1",
      "name": "Trinity as single axiom paying four debts",
      "speaker": "Framework author",
      "conclusion": "The Trinitarian God is the single axiom that grounds existence, distinction, relation, and orientation, which every other ontology assumes but cannot derive.",
      "premises": [
        "Every formal system has an unprovable floor (set theory nine axioms, Peano five, GR two postulates).",
        "Every system uses four things it cannot ground: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.",
        "The Trinity pays all four from one structure: aseity grounds existence, the persons ground distinction, perichoresis grounds relation, love grounds orientation.",
        "No other ontology derives these four; they are assumed and never paid for."
      ],
      "strength": {
        "st1": {"v": 2, "quote": "That single structure pays four debts no other ontology on earth pays."},
        "st2": {"v": 2, "quote": "Every system that exists -- materialism, idealism, mathematical Platonism, secular humanism -- uses four things it cannot ground:"},
        "st3": {"v": 1, "quote": "Set theory pays nine axioms. Peano arithmetic pays five. General relativity pays two postulates."},
        "st4": {"v": 1, "quote": "The Trinity pays all four from one structure. Existence is aseity -- the Father IS. Distinction is the persons -- the Son is not the Father, the Spirit is not the Son."},
        "st5": {"v": 0, "quote": ""},
        "st6": {"v": 1, "quote": "No system derives them. They are assumed, borrowed, and never paid for."},
        "st7": {"v": 0, "quote": ""},
        "st8": {"v": 1, "quote": "Set theory pays nine axioms. Peano arithmetic pays five. General relativity pays two postulates. This framework pays one."}
      },
      "prior_art": "Classical Trinitarian theology (Augustine, De Trinitate, c. 400); presuppositional apologetics (Cornelius Van Til, The Defense of the Faith, 1955)",
      "originality": {
        "or1": {"v": 1, "quote": "That single structure pays four debts no other ontology on earth pays.", "why": "The 'one axiom paying four debts' framing is a variant on presuppositional transcendental arguments, not a wholly different argument."},
        "or2": {"v": 1, "quote": "Set theory pays nine axioms. Peano arithmetic pays five. General relativity pays two postulates.", "why": "Uses formal-system axiom counts as new supporting data."},
        "or3": {"v": 1, "quote": "Existence is aseity -- the Father IS. Distinction is the persons -- the Son is not the Father, the Spirit is not the Son.", "why": "Connects formal-foundations discourse to Trinitarian metaphysics."},
        "or4": {"v": 0, "quote": "", "why": "No formalization or model beyond the four-debt taxonomy."}
      },
      "weakest_link": "The claim that no other ontology derives the four (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) is asserted without demonstration against any specific rival system.",
      "develop_next": "Give a worked demonstration that at least one rival ontology (e.g. mathematical Platonism) cannot ground distinction or relation without circularity.",
      "case_map": ["K01", "K02", "K17", "F1"],
      "domain": "philosophy"
    },
